optionAssessments: allein: Alone conflicts with two teams acting together.
gemeinsam: Correct: together rather than separately is jointly.
getrennt: Separately directly contradicts nicht getrennt.
unabhängig: Independently is disfavored by the express shared organization, though independent organizations can cooperate as entities.
reviewed.finding: The explicit zusammen/nicht getrennt action contrast directly identifies gemeinsam.
reviewed.rubricAndLanguage: Accepted option 1 (gemeinsam) exactly reconstructs 'Die beiden Teams planen das Fest zusammen, nicht getrennt. Sie organisieren es gemeinsam.'. Sie organisieren es gemeinsam has correct plural subject reference and adverbial use. Bilingual shared-planning hints and shared-action/facility explanations fit, without requiring identical legal organizations. Both standard instruction languages were examined; a finding requires a specific scored instruction wherever the generic accurate-completion task is insufficient.

optionAssessments: getrennte: Separate contradicts all residents sharing one kitchen.
gemeinsame: Correct intended shared-use relation.
private: A kitchen shared by residents may still be private against outside users; this is a real compatible audience-based reading.
eigene: Their own kitchen can be jointly owned or used by all the residents; this is a natural competing completion.
reviewed.finding: Gemeinsame, private and eigene describe different dimensions and can coexist. Ask specifically for shared use among the residents, rather than ownership or public access.
reviewed.rubricAndLanguage: Accepted option 1 (gemeinsame) exactly reconstructs 'Alle Bewohner teilen sich eine Küche. Es ist ihre gemeinsame Küche.'. Ihre gemeinsame Küche is correctly feminine nominative. Bilingual shared-use hints and two-sense explanations fit, but that dimension must constrain the scored instruction rather than be supplied only by optional help. Both standard instruction languages were examined; a finding requires a specific scored instruction wherever the generic accurate-completion task is insufficient.
